text: DRUG INTERACTIONS THE DEVELOPMENT OF SEVERE RENAL FAILURE HAS BEEN REPORTED IN PATIENTS TREATED WITH A SINGLE DOSE OF IV MELPHALAN FOLLOWED BY STANDARD ORAL DOSES OF CYCLOSPORINE. CISPLATIN MAY AFFECT MELPHALAN KINETICS BY INDUCING RENAL DYSFUNCTION AND SUBSEQUENTLY ALTERING MELPHALAN CLEARANCE. IV MELPHALAN MAY ALSO REDUCE THE THRESHOLD FOR BCNU LUNG TOXICITY. WHEN NALIDIXIC ACID AND IV MELPHALAN ARE GIVEN SIMULTANEOUSLY, THE INCIDENCE OF SEVERE HEMORRHAGIC NECROTIC ENTEROCOLITIS HAS BEEN REPORTED TO INCREASE IN PEDIATRIC PATIENTS. CONTRAINDICATIONS MELPHALAN SHOULD NOT BE USED IN PATIENTS WHOSE DISEASE HAS DEMONSTRATED PRIOR RESISTANCE TO THIS AGENT. PATIENTS WHO HAVE DEMONSTRATED HYPERSENSITIVITY TO MELPHALAN SHOULD NOT BE GIVEN THE DRUG.
